“INTRO DATE
Dee 2,207

ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance is hereby amended by changing all of the C1-2 Neighborhood Commercial
District symbols as shown on Map No. 6-H.

in the area bounded by:

The public alley next northwest of and parallel to South Blue Island Avenue; a line
202.40 feet west of the intersection of South Hoyne Avenue and South Blue Island
Avenue as measured along the north right of way line of South Blue Island Avenue and
perpendicular thereto; South Blue Island Avenue; and a line 226.40 feet west of the
intersection of South Hoyne Avenue and South Blue Island Avenue as measured along

the north right of way line of South Blue Island Avenue and perpendicular thereto.
To those of a B2-3 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This Ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.

Common address of property: 2480 S. Blue Island Avenue, Chicago IL
